not_covered: UI-only status words (Searchable, Last success, Healthy, Pending versus queued, Retry accepted): their source scope in copy_rules.json is scrypath_ops/lib, and the guides use accepted as a contract term.
Marketing words with no source in the three files above (seamless, blazing, powerful) are not listed.
The glossary avoid entry last successful has the source scope scrypath_ops/lib in copy_rules.json and one use in guides/operator-mix-tasks.md, so it is not a docs rule.

docs/*.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md are docs extras but are not scanned: some of them use a listed word in a negation or an internal note, and the table's scope is README.md plus guides/*.md.
Text inside fenced code blocks is not scanned; code and config samples name real option and event names.
Non-English text is not covered, and a phrase split by markup (a link, emphasis) is not matched.

rules.rule: Say what happens, not how fast: no sentence promises a time.
The brand book's do-not-say words that no doc has a reason to use: effortless, it just stays in sync, real-time, playbook, AI-powered.
The brand book's do-not-say words that are also technical terms: magic, federated, hydration. README prose does not use them.
rules.reason: The guides use these words for the [:scrypath, :hydration] telemetry event, the federation_weight: option and explicit negations (not magic), and GLOSSARY.md scopes hydration to UI copy, so the guides are not scanned for them.
rules.source: brand/BRAND.md, Do not say; GLOSSARY.md avoid entries

rules.rule: Use the glossary's current names: Control room, not Control Room; Sync and index, not the former name Sync and drift.
